repos_data.description: Word-synced desktop lyrics on macOS for Apple Music, Spotify, QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Kugou — and YouTube Music / Spotify Web in any browser. Actively maintained open-source LyricsX alternative. Floating overlay, Dynamic Island, menu bar or lyrics window; translation, romanization, Last.fm stats. | macOS 桌面歌词：逐字同步 · 翻译 · 粤拼 · LyricsX 替代
